Both make me confirm before it's gone for good, and both are clear that there's no undo — which is exactly the safeguard I'd want for permanent deletion.

Between them, the separate confirmation that pops up and spells out "This permanently removes the bookmark and can't be undone" gives me the clearest moment to stop and think, so I'd lean to that one. But either is acceptable — the important thing, that deleting for good always asks first, is there in both.
